description: This file contains a test class `NbapiAccessPoint` that performs automated tests on a network device using the Boardfarm testing framework. It covers configuration, security, and operational checks for multiple virtual access points, including interactions via API commands and topology verification.

classes.name: NbapiAccessPoint
classes.description: A test class that verifies the configuration and behavior of Access Point objects and related network parameters in a prplMesh environment.

methods.name: check_bss_is_disabled(self, ssid: str, radio, controller)
methods.description: Checks that the specified BSS (Basic Service Set) with given SSID is disabled on the radio interface by verifying the 'Enabled' parameter.

methods.name: check_bss_in_radio(self, ssid: str, radio, ssids, config, controller)
methods.description: Verifies that a BSS with a specific SSID is enabled on a radio, and that its 'FronthaulUse' and 'BackhaulUse' parameters match expected values.

methods.name: check_bss_conf(self, radio, ssid: str, config: {})
methods.description: Logs the current configuration of a particular BSS for a given SSID to aid verification.

methods.name: runTest(self)
methods.description: Main test execution method that sets up, configures, and verifies multiple Access Points, security settings, and topology states, including edge cases like WPA3-CM propagation.

ctags.name: check_bss_conf
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_bss_conf(self, radio, ssid: str, config: {}):$/

ctags.name: check_bss_in_radio
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_bss_in_radio(self, ssid: str, radio, ssids, config, controller):$/
ctags.signature: (self, ssid: str, radio, ssids, config, controller)

ctags.name: check_bss_is_disabled
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_bss_is_disabled(self, ssid: str, radio, controller):$/
